description: Python 3.9–3.11 task script compatibility, complete Codex hook context recovery, and correct fallback-session cleanup.
changelog:
**Bug Fixes:**
- fix(scripts): restore Python 3.9–3.11 compatibility in `.trellis/scripts/common/task_context.py` by removing multiline nested f-strings (#476)
- fix(codex): make `trellis-{implement,check,research}` recover saved `SubagentStart` output before trusting the injected marker (#465)
- fix(scripts): make `task.py finish` clear the resolved fallback session while preserving ambiguous or unresolved sessions (#469)
notes: Run `trellis update` to refresh task scripts and Codex sub-agent templates. No `--migrate` required.
